#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

const int MOD = 998244353;
const int MAXN = 1 << 21; // 2097152

vector<double> cs(MAXN), sn(MAXN), csi(MAXN), sni(MAXN);

void init_twiddle() {
    for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
        cs[i] = cos(2 * M_PI * i / MAXN);
        sn[i] = sin(2 * M_PI * i / MAXN);
        csi[i] = cos(-2 * M_PI * i / MAXN);
        sni[i] = sin(-2 * M_PI * i / MAXN);
    }
}

int reverseBits(int x, int bits) {
    int res = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < bits; ++i) {
        res = (res << 1) | (x & 1);
        x >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

void fft(vector<double>& a, vector<double>& b, bool inverse) {
    int n = a.size();
    int bits = 0;
    int temp = n;
    while (temp > 1) {
        temp >>= 1;
        bits++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        int j = reverseBits(i, bits);
        if (i < j) {
            swap(a[i], a[j]);
            swap(b[i], b[j]);
        }
    }
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int halfLen = len >> 1;
        int w = MAXN / len;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0, k = 0; j < halfLen; ++j, k += w) {
                double wA = inverse ? csi[k] : cs[k];
                double wB = inverse ? sni[k] : sn[k];
                double uA = a[i + j];
                double uB = b[i + j];
                double vA = a[i + j + halfLen] * wA - b[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                double vB = a[i + j + halfLen] * wB + b[i + j + halfLen] * wA;
                a[i + j] = uA + vA;
                b[i + j] = uB + vB;
                a[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                b[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
            }
        }
    }
    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            a[i] /= n;
            b[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

vector<int> multiplyMod(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int n = 2;
    while (n < need) n <<= 1;

    vector<double> aLowReal(n, 0.0), aLowImag(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> aHighReal(n, 0.0), aHighImag(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); ++i) {
        int x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        aLowReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        aHighReal[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(aLowReal, aLowImag, false);
    fft(aHighReal, aHighImag, false);

    vector<double> bLowReal(n, 0.0), bLowImag(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> bHighReal(n, 0.0), bHighImag(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); ++i) {
        int x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        bLowReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        bHighReal[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(bLowReal, bLowImag, false);
    fft(bHighReal, bHighImag, false);

    vector<double> lowLowReal(n), lowLowImag(n);
    vector<double> midReal(n), midImag(n);
    vector<double> highHighReal(n), highHighImag(n);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        lowLowReal[i] = aLowReal[i] * bLowReal[i] - aLowImag[i] * bLowImag[i];
        lowLowImag[i] = aLowReal[i] * bLowImag[i] + aLowImag[i] * bLowReal[i];

        double lhReal = aLowReal[i] * bHighReal[i] - aLowImag[i] * bHighImag[i];
        double lhImag = aLowReal[i] * bHighImag[i] + aLowImag[i] * bHighReal[i];

        double hlReal = aHighReal[i] * bLowReal[i] - aHighImag[i] * bLowImag[i];
        double hlImag = aHighReal[i] * bLowImag[i] + aHighImag[i] * bLowReal[i];

        midReal[i] = lhReal + hlReal;
        midImag[i] = lhImag + hlImag;

        highHighReal[i] = aHighReal[i] * bHighReal[i] - aHighImag[i] * bHighImag[i];
        highHighImag[i] = aHighReal[i] * bHighImag[i] + aHighImag[i] * bHighReal[i];
    }

    fft(lowLowReal, lowLowImag, true);
    fft(midReal, midImag, true);
    fft(highHighReal, highHighImag, true);

    vector<int> res(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; ++i) {
        long long low = (long long)(lowLowReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long mid = (long long)(midReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long high = (long long)(highHighReal[i] + 0.5);
        res[i] = (int)((low + ((mid % mod) << 15) + ((high % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    init_twiddle();

    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        v[x] = 1;
    }

    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int p = n / 2;
    while (p > 0) {
        if (p & 1) {
            ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, MOD);
        }
        p >>= 1;
        if (p == 0) break;
        v = multiplyMod(v, v, MOD);
    }

    long long res = 0;
    for (int x : ans) {
        res = (res + (long long)x * x) % MOD;
    }
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
